content: Former BSP Lok Sabha candidate, student leaders, grassroots politicians, and workers of social and political groups join Congress; party says this is proof the winds of change are blowing against the BJP in U.P.

content: Mr. Kumaraswamy interacted with farmers who lost their land for the NICE project and received their representations. He promised the farmers that he would fight against the project.

content: J&K Apni Party president urges Prime Minister Narendra Modi to initiate a direct dialogue with the people of J&K ‘to address their issues and grievances’, and says, ‘The prevailing trust deficit will not end until direct talks are held between the Centre and the people, particularly the youth of J&K’

title: Minister unveils ‘Godavari declaration’ to promote tourism ahead of Godavari Pushkarams-2027
content: Kandula Durgesh announces that a tent city and Havelock bridge will be developed ahead of the Godavari Pushkarams.

title: 40-year-old demand for road to Scheduled Caste village causes communal rift in Nilgiris
content: As many as 40 Sri Lankan-repatriate Scheduled Caste families in Ambal Colony, Kil Kotagiri, were set to benefit from a short road near their hamlet. However, the road laying project approved on September 3 has now sparked communal tensions.

content: Four-day event records around 58,000 B2B meetings, besides discussions on tapping emerging opportunities

content: The initiative is aimed at reducing dependence on conventional diesel fuel and promoting the use of alternative energy sources in railway operations.

content: "I see AI as an opportunity and then as a challenge," Chief of Defence Staff General NS Raja Subramani said at the NDTV Defence Summit.

content: In Punjab, where drugs have occupied an unusually prominent place in public and electoral politics for years, allegations of drug use carry a political charge that goes well beyond an individual's private conduct.

content: The matter came to light when the landlord, who came to inspect the rented premises at Prestige Colony in the Bindayaka area, found the house locked and noticed a woman's hand protruding from freshly dug soil in the garden.

content: NDTV Defence Summit 2026 Highlights: The summit will feature addresses and discussions with the chiefs of the Army, Navy and Air Force, along with the Chief of Defence Staff and senior defence officials.

content: Indian Navy chief Vice Admiral Krishna Swaminathan has invited private space technology start-up Skyroot Aerospace to collaborate in "mission mode" to understand the defense-specific requirements in the country and help develop world-class, sovereign space capabilities over the next 20-25 years.

title: Hyderabad Gym Owner Charged For Harassing Woman Cop During Ganesh Immersion
content: A man allegedly approached the cop and misbehaved with her while also obstructing her from carrying out her official duties, according to the complaint.

title: Weather Tomorrow: Heavy Rain Forecast In Parts Of Uttarakhand, UP, Bihar, Assam, Meghalaya
content: The Northeast is likely to remain one of the more active weather zones, while parts of western India will also see rain activity.

title: Russian Envoy Claims "A Freudian Slip" Revealed US Fears Of India's Rise
content: Speaking at the NDTV Defence Summit on Sunday, Denis Alipov claimed the comment had been made during this year's Raisina Dialogue in the national capital.

title: 'Indian Ocean Region Among Most Militarised': Navy Chief Flags Threats
content: The rise of Asian economies such as India and China over the last five decades, along with other geopolitical factors, has made the Indian Ocean "an increasingly congested and contested maritime space", said Admiral Krishna Swaminathan.

title: "AAP Worker Abused My Family": Delhi Minister Parvesh Verma On Slap Row
content: Claiming that the AAP was promoting the slap video, Parvesh Verma accused the AAP MLA Jarnail Singh of corruption, adding "please understand the truth behind the video".

title: Parvesh Verma slap row: Man files complaint, police reveal prior FIR against him
content: Delhi Police has received a complaint regarding an alleged incident involving Minister Parvesh Verma. The complaint states that Verma slapped a man during a road inspection in Tilak Nagar. AAP leader Jarnail Singh was present and questioned the quality of the road when the incident occurred. Verma disputes the allegations, claiming the video does not show the full context.

title: ‘Illegal detention by Assam Police has finally ended’: CJP’s Ranka to address press
content: Ashutosh Ranka, co-convenor of the Cockroach Janta Party, reported his detention by Assam Police has ended. He stated that he will address the media after being taken back to the original pick-up location. Several other CJP leaders were also detained in Guwahati before a regional volunteers' meeting near the Assam Secretariat. Police prevented access to the meeting site, which aimed to gather around 200-300 volunteers from the region.

title: 'Won't bow our head': Iran embassy invokes Baahubali to echo Pezeshkian's UN speech
content: Highlighting the parallels between resilience and heroism, the Iranian Embassy in Hyderabad unveiled a video featuring President Masoud Pezeshkian's UNGA address likened to the epic tale of Baahubali. The embassy conveyed Iran's steadfastness against external pressures, as exemplified in Dr. Pezeshkian's rejection of U.S. sanctions. He asserted Iran's commitment to dialogue while maintaining a robust defense posture, amidst escalating U.S.-Iran tensions.

title: 15,000 runs for Kohli! Virat joins Sachin Tendulkar in ODI record book
content: Virat Kohli reached 15,002 runs from 315 matches and 303 innings. He has scored 54 centuries and 80 fifties in ODIs, with a highest score of 183. His ODI batting average stands at 58.83, while his strike rate is more than 94.

title: Asian Games: Athletics leads India’s seven-medal haul, three boxers assure medals
content: India showcased a stellar performance at the Asian Games 2026, clinching a total of seven medals, predominantly in athletics and squash. Parul Chaudhary shone brightly, securing a bronze in the women’s 3000m steeplechase. Silver medals were added by Ancy Sojan and Sarvesh Kushare in their respective disciplines. The boxing team also excelled, confirming three medals through successful semifinal performances.

title: New Green Card rules from September: Categories affected and those exempt
content: Beginning in September 2026, the USCIS unveiled new regulations affecting Green Card seekers. These guidelines emphasize the financial self-sufficiency of applicants while excluding those in humanitarian categories. Nearly all applicants, including family and various occupational groups, must satisfy these criteria. While the Form I-864, Affidavit of Support, is crucial, it cannot guarantee approval on its own.

title: $17.1M to restore 206,000 acres, 225 miles for wildlife movement in West
content: The National Fish and Wildlife Foundation has announced $13.3 million in grants for 14 projects across the western US. With $3.8 million in matching contributions, the conservation work will have a total impact of $17.1 million. The projects will restore habitat, improve migration corridors and modify 225 miles of fencing for wildlife.

title: Nepal battered by severe rain: 21 dead, 5 missing as floods, landslides worsen
content: In Nepal, heavy rainfall has caused devastating floods and landslides, resulting in 21 lives lost and extensive damage. Authorities have evacuated around 3,000 residents from perilous areas to guarantee their safety. This deluge follows the earlier Bhotekoshi floods, which had a death toll of over 1,400. As rescue efforts continue, landslides have disrupted operations in several districts, and tourists in vulnerable areas are being advised to take precautions.

title: 'I promised myself': Virat Kohli after 15,000-run landmark
content: Virat Kohli became only the second batter after Sachin Tendulkar to complete 15,000 ODI runs. He also hit his record-extending 55th ODI century as India beat West Indies by eight wickets in the first ODI. Kohli said his priority has always been to understand the situation and do what the team needs.

title: IndiGo A321 enroute Blr suffers tail strike; plane lands safely in second attempt
content: On Sunday, an IndiGo Airbus A321 operating flight 6E 6542 experienced a tail strike during a go-around. The incident occurred while attempting to land in gusty weather at Bengaluru airport. All passengers and crew were safely disembarked, and the aircraft is undergoing maintenance checks. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation is investigating the incident and has engaged with IndiGo regarding pilot training enhancements.

title: $5,000 gift in 1999 turned China desert into 50,000-tree forest
content: Pennsylvania teacher Ronald Sakolsky reunited with Chinese farmer Yin Yuzhen 26 years after donating $5,000 to support her tree-planting efforts in Inner Mongolia. His contribution helped Yin expand her work in the Maowusu Desert, which has since become a forest of around 50,000 trees, turning their friendship into an enduring environmental story.

title: 3 turbines, $35K a year: How wind power cut Iowa farmer's debt by 80%
content: Evie Haupt, an Iowa farmer, has notably increased her revenue by leasing land for wind turbines. This extra income has been instrumental in alleviating her farm debts following her husband's passing. Even though the turbines occupy less than an acre, she continues her traditional farming practices on the bulk of her land. The rise of wind power is transforming the financial prospects for rural landowners nationwide.

title: Florida used robot rabbits to hunt Burmese pythons threatening the Everglades
content: Florida is testing solar-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. Developed by the South Florida Water Management District and University of Florida, the robotic decoys mimic prey using heat and scent while AI cameras detect approaching snakes. Officials can then alert trained removal agents, adding technology to Florida’s wider python control efforts.

title: Rob Lowe says he was happy after Will Smith slapped Chris Rock at Oscars
content: Rob Lowe has revealed he was “the only person happy” when Will Smith slapped Chris Rock at the 2022 Oscars, hoping the shocking incident would overshadow his infamous 1989 Academy Awards performance. Lowe joked that his decades-old Oscars blunder continues to haunt him, despite Smith’s slap becoming one of Hollywood’s biggest controversies.

title: Bank closure this week: When and where will banks stay shut from Sept 28 to Oct 4
content: Prepare for some interruptions in banking services next week as banks will be closing for several days. A nationwide strike is set from September 28 to 30, followed by a holiday on October 2. While you can still access digital banking, in-person services will be limited. Make sure to visit your local branch after the closure, and remember to verify the holiday hours before going out.

title: US rejects Iran's claim of capturing underwater drone, calls move 'desperate'
content: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has reported the capture of a US underwater drone in the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. In response, the US military dismissed this assertion, clarifying that the drone in question had experienced a malfunction prior to any claims from Iran. This development follows Iran's earlier announcement regarding another US military drone capture.

title: Jason and Kylie Kelce’s investment reaches 5,000 stores in $2.9 billion move
content: Jason Kelce has made a savvy equity investment in Hank Sauce via Winnie Capital, marking a significant step for both him and the brand. Once a local staple, Hank Sauce now boasts distribution in over 5,000 stores across the country. With a U.S. hot sauce market worth nearly $2.9 billion, this partnership looks to amplify Hank Sauce's visibility and reach nationally, taking advantage of the substantial growth opportunities ahead.

title: Shohei Ohtani’s $700 million Dodgers contract and what it means for MLB
content: Shohei Ohtani’s $700 million contract with the Los Angeles Dodgers sounds like a blockbuster headline figure, but the deal is far more unusual than that. The deal shifted the Dodgers' payroll strategy with $680 million deferred until 2034-43, and Ohtani's commercial appeal drew major attention in Japan and around the world. The deal also helped to change how massive player contracts can be structured by MLB teams.

title: Panda-monium: When diplomacy goes to the dogs, horses, and elephants
content: Get ready, Atlanta! Two charming giant pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, will be gracing the zoo with their presence this Monday, thanks to a decade-long conservation agreement. This unique event reflects the tradition of panda diplomacy, which has played a pivotal role in fostering international friendships. The nuances of this approach reveal essential lessons in both diplomacy and environmental conservation.

title: '40km chase': Cop clings to speeding car to catch smugglers in Coimbatore; watch
content: In Coimbatore district, Kovilpalayam police engaged in a thrilling 40km chase after suspected smugglers failed to heed police signals. Remarkably, a daring officer climbed onto the suspects' vehicle during the pursuit, making it a high-stakes operation. The pursuit came to an end when the police successfully intercepted the fleeing car, leading to the suspects' arrest. However, details about the smuggling operation are still scarce.

title: LPU row escalates: Stones pelted, vehicles set on fire as police lathicharge students
content: Students at Lovely Professional University protested against unverified claims of a rape on campus, leading to unrest. The protest intensified as students blocked the Jalandhar-Phagwara National Highway, causing significant traffic disruption. Police attempted to resolve the situation but were met with stone-pelting from protesters, resulting in injuries on both sides.

title: Virat Kohli breaks Sachin Tendulkar's record for most ODI centuries against a team
content: The century was Virat Kohli's 55th in ODI cricket. It was also his 86th international hundred. His international centuries include 30 in Tests, 55 in ODIs and one in T20Is. Kohli has now scored 55 ODI hundreds, extending his lead among active players in the format.

title: France steps in to protect Saudi oil infrastructure as Houthi attacks intensify
content: France's military support to Saudi Arabia will involve deploying troops and defense systems to protect key energy infrastructure. The deployment follows repeated Houthi attacks on Saudi oil facilities and aims to secure the Red Sea port of Yanbu. French official Jean-Noel Barrot emphasized that France's role is strictly defensive and does not equate to participation in the conflict.

title: ‘How can you keep that hunger?’ Patrick Mahomes warns Chiefs
content: Patrick Mahomes, the Kansas City Chiefs’ popular quarterback, has weighed in on the team's performance as he gears up to face the Miami Dolphins.

title: CJP says Mumbai Police denied Oct 2 protest permission, launches 'Jail Bharo Andolan'
content: The Cockroach Janta Party is gearing up for a protest in Mumbai after being denied police permission. Founder Abhijeet Dipke announced plans for a Jail Bharo Andolan on Gandhi Jayanti. This announcement follows reports of CJP co-convener Ashutosh Ranka and volunteers facing detention in Assam. NCP (SP) spokesperson Anish Gawande condemned the detentions, labeling them illegal and unconstitutional. The CJP remains dedicated to advocating for social issues despite these setbacks.

title: Asian Games: Why India dropped out of top 10 despite winning seven more medals
content: India added seven medals on Day 8 of the Asian Games, including two silver medals in squash and five in athletics. Parul Chaudhary achieved a new national record in the women's 3000m steeplechase, winning bronze. However, India did not win any gold medals, leading to a drop in its overall standings. Boxers Parveen Hooda, Ankush Panghal, and Narender secured medals by reaching the semifinals.

title: IIT-B student suicide: What law says about abetment, instigation and ‘guilty mind’
content: The heartbreaking suicide of a second-year IIT-Bombay student has ignited debates over complex legal matters concerning abetment. Professor Suryanarayana Doolla finds himself charged with abetting the tragedy, drawing emotional protests from the victim's family. The rarity of successful prosecutions in such cases poses additional challenges, as the Supreme Court insists on clear evidence of intentional instigation.

title: Tamil Nadu govt rolls back law and order department’s RTI exemption amid backlash
content: The Tamil Nadu government faced backlash after it issued a notification that exempted the Public (Law and Order) Department from the Right to Information (RTI) Act. Critics, including numerous political leaders, argued that such an action would jeopardize transparency and obstruct public access to crucial law records. In response to widespread criticism, the government promptly withdrew the exemption, reaffirming its commitment to uphold the RTI Act.

title: Gold and silver outlook: Job data, crude and more in focus to guide bullion this week
content: The gold and silver markets are poised for significant fluctuations as crucial US jobs and inflation data are on the horizon. Investors are keenly aware of the Federal Reserve's hints about possible policy adjustments, which could greatly influence precious metals. Additionally, consumer confidence, GDP figures, and inflation metrics from the Eurozone are on the radar.

title: NEET leak fallout: CISF to guard NTA’s confidential exam areas
content: Responding to the alarming issue of exam paper leaks, the National Testing Agency has fortified its security protocols. A dedicated team of 29 CISF personnel is now assigned to the agency's new office for rigorous oversight. In addition to advancing cybersecurity measures, the NTA is revisiting its entire examination-cycle systems to thwart unauthorized access. Independent audits will also be conducted, aiming for a significant improvement in examination integrity moving forward.

title: ‘Hurled abuses at my family’: Delhi minister reveals ‘truth’ behind viral slap video
content: During a recent road inspection in Tilak Nagar, Delhi's PWD Minister Parvesh Verma faced backlash after a video emerged of him allegedly slapping a local youth. Verma stated that he acted in response to an insult aimed at his family from the youth's associate. Additionally, he accused local MLA Jarnail Singh of trying to extract commissions from roadwork contracts. Following the incident, Verma's engineer has filed an FIR.

title: 'Giving back to my country': Dubai teen uses birthday savings to build solar plant in UP
content: Vehaan Subramanian, an 18-year-old from Dubai, created a water treatment plant in Uttar Pradesh. The project, named ARUNA, treats arsenic-contaminated groundwater for local communities. Funding was primarily sourced from his personal savings and a reading club he managed. Residents were trained to operate and maintain the facility for sustainable access to clean water. This initiative exemplifies the collaborative efforts between local government and citizens addressing critical water quality issues.

title: Who is Sarvesh Kushare? From Hangzhou heartbreak to Asian Games silver in Japan
content: Kushare cleared 2.25m to finish second. Chinese Taipei's Chao-hsuan Fu also cleared 2.25m but won gold, while South Korea's Sanghyeok Woo took bronze with a best effort of 2.22m. He cleared 2.10m, 2.14m, 2.18m, 2.22m and 2.25m before failing to clear 2.28m in all three attempts.

title: Barrier-free tolling: How FASTag & number plates will auto-collect toll
content: With barrier-free tolling, vehicles can move through at normal highway speeds while cameras and FASTag systems identify the vehicle and collect the toll automatically.

title: Chess Olympiad: Savitha heroics bring medal; Arjun helps India bag Open silver
content: India secured a memorable double podium at the Chess Olympiad in Samarkand. Savitha Shri’s resilient 83-move draw sealed bronze for the women, while Arjun Erigaisi’s dramatic late victory helped the open team win silver on tiebreak. Uzbekistan took open gold and China won women’s gold. India also claimed the Gaprindashvili Cup for the best combined performance.

title: Asian Games: Tejaswin Shankar wins decathlon bronze after 1500m triumph
content: In an impressive display of athleticism, Tejaswin Shankar clinched the decathlon bronze medal at the Asian Games by triumphing in the 1500m race. With a remarkable total of 7,934 points, he secured a podium position, while Japan's Yuma Maruyama took the gold. Meanwhile, Ancy Sojan finished just shy of gold in the women's long jump, placing second behind China's Yingying Huang.

title: New homes, new jobs: Why this Denver-area ZIP code is drawing movers
content: Aurora, Colorado's 80019 ZIP code is now the most popular destination for movers in the United States. The ranking is based on a significant number of new housing developments in the area. Fort Leavenworth, Kansas, remains in second place due to military relocations that dominate its movement figures. Florida has three spots in the top ten, appealing to retirees and remote workers.

title: 'Oye maar kaise raha hai': On cam, Delhi minister Parvesh Verma slaps man
content: Captured on video during a road inspection in Tilak Nagar, Delhi, PWD Minister Parvesh Verma's unexpected slap to a young man has stirred controversy. Released by the Aam Aadmi Party, the footage shows Verma confronting the individual before a security guard intervenes. This incident has ignited debate regarding the behavior of public servants in the line of duty, attracting the attention of numerous onlookers.

title: Kashmera backs Sunita Ahuja: Actor questions Komal Rani’s affair claims
content: Kashmera Shah defended Sunita Ahuja after Komal Rani's cryptic Instagram note, calling it the first time women in their family were labelled "murderers" for protecting loved ones. Komal Rani questioned Sunita's intentions without naming her. The controversy follows affair rumours between Govinda and Komal Rani, his 'Roopa' co-star, since earlier this year.

title: Asian Games: Ancy Sojan misses gold by 2cm, Shaili loses bronze on final jump
content: In a nail-biting finish at the Asian Games 2026, Ancy Sojan just fell short of clinching the gold medal in the women's long jump, achieving a stellar jump of 6.53m, only to be bested by China's Yingying Huang at 6.55m. Shaili Singh, meanwhile, faced disappointment, slipping to fourth place with a last jump that pushed her down after Mengyi Tan's leap.

title: Waterfront Estate for sale: 16-acre Marshall property hits the market for $13m
content: the 16-acre property in the tiny oyster-farming village of Marshall is suddenly up for grabs . it is a long-held commercial and residential estate with established businesses, rental income and development potential . the property was purchased in 1925 by Croatian immigrants Nickola and Nickolina Vilicich .

title: 'American terrorist army': Iran claims second US submarine seized in Hormuz
